## Illustrative UX Assessment

### Example usability scores (not actual client results)

```{r}

ggplot(metrics, aes(x=reorder(metric,score),y=score)) + geom_col(fill="#567c82") + coord_flip() + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL,y="Illustrative score / 100") + theme_minimal(base_size=13)
```

## Recommendations

- Make consultation calls to action easy to find on desktop and mobile.
- Clarify navigation between location-specific information.
- Highlight doctor profiles, patient testimonials, and insurance information.
- Use GA4 events to evaluate inquiry button clicks and form starts when access is granted.

**Data note:** This dashboard uses explicitly illustrative scores for demonstration. No actual patient, GA4, or client performance data is represented.
